title: Signer-first environment deployment-unit management
observed_behavior_before: Environment unit helpers depended on the REST environment detail read, which could fail with a missing Authorization response even though mutations were signed ContextVM requests.
Complete-set unit replacement made client-side preservation and conflict handling part of the safety boundary.
intended_behavior: Environment unit list, create, and update read through the signed environment/get-details ContextVM method and never fall back to REST.
Authorized signed reads return environment targeting, updated_at, and explicit or resolved implicit deployment units.
Complete-set updates preserve pre-existing units by Key, including git_source, and enforce expected_updated_at with bounded reread-remerge retries.
A Bahia-managed Compose unit added to an edge-01-docker-shaped environment can be selected by deploy preview, deploy intent, and route-attach planning.
